title: A wing below water
hook: A wing can be useful away from the sky.

knows: Animals have structures and activities that can be studied.
doesNotKnow: The highlighted wing and water arrow sketch a propulsive stroke through water. Penguin wings are modified as flippers used for swimming, even though modern penguins cannot fly in air. The drawing simplifies the motion and does not measure speed or forces.

misconception: The features shown in this question have only one possible interpretation.
objective: A penguin swims underwater using its wings. What do those wings chiefly do in this situation?
